one_line: A POV headline over a child laughing at his own book, then a cover held beside his face as proof.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 medium shot: a woman on a sofa holds an open picture book while a boy leans over it, laughing. Headline: "פוב: האחיין שלך מכור לדינוזאורים אז יצרת לו ספר מיוחד והוא הדמות הראשית". Subtitle at 0:02.
q1_hook.why: A POV headline names a relatable situation, a child obsessed with dinosaurs, and a boy already laughing over the book is the reaction proof in 3 s (H1, K3, K8). Text arrives early (T3, H6), the book is in hand (S1), and a face and a voice are there at once (H4).

beats.what: A woman reads on a sofa, a boy leans over the book laughing; POV headline; "דינוזאור", "הנה הדינוזאור"
beats.why: Humour and a real reaction from the first second

beats.what: A page of an illustrated boy hugging a dinosaur; a boy lies over the book talking
beats.why: The child's own words about the hero on the page

beats.what: Two boys beside the woman, who holds the book; "הנה הדינוזאור שלי", "אז תכירו את"
beats.why: Leads from the skit into the brand

beats.what: A paper band, then the MeBook.ai box; "MEBOOK", "ספר שבו הילד שלכם הוא הגיבור הראשי"
beats.why: A clear reset: the skit ends, the pitch begins

beats.what: Two books lifted from the box; "אי אפשר לפספס את ההתלהבות"
A boy opens a book; "אתם רק צריכים לבחור סיפור", "להעלות תמונה וזה מוכן"
beats.why: The whole process in two short lines

beats.what: A boy in a kitchen and a woman in a leopard dress hold books; "להעביר מסר חשוב"
The boy holds the cover beside his face; a catalogue page; "ואפילו השגתי לכם קוד קופון"
beats.why: Proof and ask in the last 4 s

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked. Nothing invites a comment, save, share or tag in the video or the caption, which ends on how to buy.
q2_flow.why: The first 16 s run on a child's real, funny reaction before any selling (K3, K8, H1). A clear reset at 0:16, "אז תכירו את MEBOOK", turns to the explanation (R3). The boy holding the cover beside his face at 0:37 is a late payoff (R4, S2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled 0:36 to 0:41: "מבטיחה שתתאהבו", "ואפילו השגתי לכם קוד קופון שווה במיוחד". The code is not said or shown. Caption: a link in her story and a code to enter at checkout.
q3_cta.why: The offer comes after the benefits, said and subtitled in the last 4 s (C6), but the code and link live in the caption and her story, so the viewer must leave the Reel. A story link plus a code are two actions (C1); no comment word is used (C3).

q4_shown.what: A boy laughing over a page of an illustrated boy with a dinosaur (0:00 to 0:11); the MeBook.ai box and two books lifted out (0:16 to 0:26); a boy holding the cover beside his face (0:37); a catalogue page (0:39). No price.
q4_shown.why: A child laughing at himself as the hero is vivid proof (K8, K1). The boy holding the cover beside his face at 0:37 is a real face next to the illustration for about 2 s (S2, S8). The page is upside down at 0:06 to 0:11 (F5), and children's faces and names show (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 18 shots in 41 s, 2.3 s each; 16 s of real family footage, then voiceover over unboxing and reaction clips; hard cuts, some blur. Subtitles with yellow keywords. POV headline 0:00 to 0:04. Ends on a catalogue page.
q5_edit.why: Real laughter early and a cut every 2 s keep attention up (E1, E2). Subtitles with yellow keywords track the speech from 0:02 (E4, T2). It ends right after the last line, no end card (E8), but 41 s is long for a skit plus a pitch (R2).

q6_topic.what: A child laughing at his own dinosaur book, then a teacher's pitch: pick a story, upload a photo, topics from first grade to the pacifier. Serves gift buyers and parents.
q6_topic.why: A humour skit from a real kid moment, a child obsessed with dinosaurs, sells the book before any pitch (K3, K1). The headline names a buyer, an aunt or uncle, and the caption a holiday gift (K7, R5). The voice adds modest developmental lines, support, a message, empowerment (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone footage at home: a sofa scene at eye level, close top-down shots of the book (some upside down), an unboxing on a rug, a kitchen scene, a boy holding up a cover. Warm indoor light. Two women, two boys.
q7_filmed.why: Real home footage with natural reactions looks native (H8, F7). The unboxing is top-down with the cover filling the frame (F5, F4), but the first page shots are upside down and blurred (F5). Subtitles sit at 73 to 79% of frame height, in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Headline at the top, 0:00 to 0:04, thin white, four short lines: "פוב: האחיין שלך מכור לדינוזאורים אז יצרת לו ספר מיוחד והוא הדמות הראשית". Subtitles from 0:02, white bold with yellow keywords, two lines, at 73 to 79% of the frame height: "הנה הדינוזאור" (0:03), "MEBOOK" (0:17), "אתם רק צריכים לבחור סיפור," (0:25), "מבטיחה שתתאהבו," (0:37), "ואפילו השגתי לכם קוד קופון שווה במיוחד" (0:38).
q8_text.caption: "ספר שבו הילד שלכם הוא הגיבור הראשי" with a technology claim, then "זה לגמרי אמיתי." About 120 words: the product, her gan-teacher credentials, a holiday gift line, a how-to-buy paragraph with the story link and her code. No hashtags, no question, no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: A Hebrew-letter headline names the situation from the first frame (T3, T6), and subtitles with yellow keywords work muted (T1, T2) but sit in the bottom 35% (T4). The caption opens with the product but has no hashtags and no disclosure words, though it offers a code (T7, T8).

weak_points: A chaotic first 16 s with garbled kid speech and some upside-down pages; the code and link are not in the video; two asks; no disclosure words; children's names on covers and in speech.
lumebook_takeaway: Film hands holding the cover beside the child's photo, a three-step recap and one CTA; open with a POV headline in Hebrew letters; no child on camera.
not_verified: Which adult is the creator; music (cannot hear); the discount percentage; the children's names on the covers and in the speech (not copied). The first 16 s of the transcript is garbled kid speech, so the subtitles were used. Whether "תציצו באתר" (transcript, 0:36) is subtitled (the frames show only "מבטיחה שתתאהבו"). Correction to src/coded: the POV headline is visible about 0:00 to 0:04, and the dinosaur page is upside down at 0:06 to 0:11.
